description: This source file implements string-to-map data structures and associated operations, including initialization, insertion, lookup, removal, and iteration for string maps and sets, with support for memory pools and string duplication options.

methods.name: void strmap_clear(struct strmap * map,int free_values)

methods.name: void strmap_partial_clear(struct strmap * map,int free_values)
methods.description: Partially clears the map, freeing entries but not the entire structure.

methods.name: struct:strmap_entry * create_entry(struct strmap * map,const char * str,void * data)
methods.description: Creates a new map entry with optional string duplication and memory pooling.

methods.name: void * strmap_put(struct strmap * map,const char * str,void * data)
methods.description: Adds or updates an entry in the map.

methods.name: struct:strmap_entry * strmap_get_entry(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Retrieves the entry for a given key.

methods.name: void * strmap_get(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key.

methods.name: int strmap_contains(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the map.

methods.name: void strmap_remove(struct strmap * map,const char * str,int free_value)
